integrity: The exceptional-point classification is proved analytically from the published characteristic determinant, its boundary-triple resolvent formula, and a contour-trace multiplicity argument. The accompanying computation checks symbolic identities and representative examples only.
scientific_limitations: Massive one-dimensional single-point interaction only; isolated eigenvalues off the essential rays; the spectral-flooding matrices and threshold points are excluded; no pseudospectral or finite-width regularization claim is made.
title: Exceptional-point locus and square-root unfolding for a non-self-adjoint relativistic point interaction
